copy.headline: Denis Villeneuve “Deeply Disappointed” Disney Put ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Against ‘Dune 3’
copy.caption:
The director breaks silence on going head-to-head against Marvel's titan on "Dunesday." Everybody has found it pretty cute, if slightly baffling, that expected box-office heavyweights Dune: Part Three and Avengers: Doomsday are opening on the same day (Dec. 18).

But Dune franchise director Denis Villeneuve isn’t amused by going head-to-head with the Marvel titan.

story.title: Denis Villeneuve “Deeply Disappointed” Disney Put ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Against ‘Dune 3’
story.summary: The director breaks silence on going head-to-head against Marvel's titan on "Dunesday." Logo text Everybody has found it pretty cute, if slightly baffling, that expected box-office heavyweights Dune: Part Three and Avengers: Doomsday are opening on the same day (Dec. 18). But Dune franchise director Denis Villeneuve isn’t amused by going head-to-head with the Marvel titan. Villeneuve explains in a new interview that he was “deeply disappointed” by the “Dunesday” scheduling, but that Warner Bros. was basically trapped in the slot because the studio had successfully secured an exclusive run on IMAX screens for Dune 3 through the December holidays.
